meta.description: Cary movers for new-construction homes, HOA communities and families relocating from other states. Hourly local billing, our own trucks. Free quote.

overview: Many Cary moves end at a brand-new house with a gate code, an HOA and a closing date that keeps shifting. Our Triangle crews plan around all three.
And if you're arriving from another state, we can carry the whole move on our own truck.
sellingPoints: New-build closings and HOA rules planned in
Families arriving from out of state
Storage if the house isn't ready

servicesBlock.h2: Cary Moving Services for New and Growing Homes
servicesBlock.intro: In Cary we pair residential moves with packing, storage while a build finishes, or a long distance move from out of state. The full list is below.

whyChoose.h2: Why Cary Homeowners Move With Better Life Moving

cards.title: Closing-Day Flexibility
cards.text: If the builder's date slips, we can hold your things in storage and deliver when the keys arrive.

cards.title: Gate and Community Rules
cards.text: Share the gate code, parking rules and any HOA quiet hours, and the crew schedules the move inside them.

cards.title: Out-of-State Arrivals
cards.text: Coming from Massachusetts, Illinois or California? We run crews in those markets too, and our own truck makes the drive.

cards.title: Rate Includes the Wrapping
cards.text: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and truck costs (gas, mileage, tolls) are included in the hourly rate for local moves.

faqHeading: Questions From People Moving to Cary

faq.q: Can Cary movers handle a new-construction closing that keeps moving?
faq.a: Yes. We can pick up on your original date, store everything and deliver when the house closes. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: What do you need to know about my Cary HOA?
faq.a: Gate codes, where trucks may park and any hours the community restricts moving. Send them with your quote request.

faq.q: How much does a local move in Cary cost?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Your quote shows the rate.

faq.q: We're moving to Cary from another state. Do you do that?
faq.a: Yes. It's a long distance move, quoted at a flat rate and driven by our own crew.

faq.q: Can the crew unpack in our new Cary home?
faq.a: Yes. Add unpacking to the quote and the crew empties boxes and puts things away in the rooms you choose.

faqClosing: Got another question about your Cary move? Our FAQ page has more on pricing and moving day.

closing.h2: Get Moved Into Your Cary Home
closing.body: Send the closing date and both addresses. We'll work out the move, the storage if you need it and the price with you.
